info.title: Notara REST API
info.description:
Automate Notara — create and manage pages, write blocks, query databases and search content programmatically. ## Authentication Every request must be authenticated with one of: 1. **API key** (recommended for scripts): set the `Authorization` header: ``` Authorization: Bearer ntr_ ``` Generate keys in your workspace settings → API keys. A key carries a scope, and each operation declares the scope it needs: a **read** key may call the operations that only read and gets `403` on one that changes state; a **write** key can do anything you can. The scope is fixed when the key is created. 2. **Session cookie**: if you're calling from a browser that is already signed in, the session cookie is sent automatically. ## Base URL All paths below are relative to `/api/v1`. For example, `GET /workspaces` → `GET /api/v1/workspaces`. ## Block content format A block's `content` is always a **string**, sent and returned exactly as stored. How to read it depends on the block type. Text-bearing blocks hold **HTML**, because the editor produces and consumes HTML: | Type | Example | |------|---------| | paragraph | `"

Hello

"` | | heading1/2/3 | `"

Title

"` | | bulletList / numberedList | `"
  • Item
"` | | todo | `"
  • Task
"` | | blockquote | `"
Quoted
"` | | code | `"
const x = 1
"` | | toggle / callout | HTML, with block-specific attributes | | divider | `""` | Structured blocks hold a **JSON string**: | Type | Example | |------|---------| | image / pdf / file | `"{\"src\":\"/attachments/01H….png\",\"fileName\":\"diagram.png\"}"` | | pageLink | `"{\"pageId\":\"01H…\"}"` | | database | `"{\"databaseId\":\"01H…\"}"` | | viewReference | `"{\"databaseId\":\"01H…\",\"viewId\":\"01H…\"}"` | Sending a JSON **object** rather than a string is rejected with 422. Earlier versions of this document described `{ "text": "…" }` objects for text blocks; that was never what the server stored, and content written that way rendered blank. If you have blocks created that way, rewrite them as HTML.

BearerAuth.description: API key with `ntr_` prefix. Generate one in workspace settings. A read-scoped key is refused with `403` on any request that changes state.

token.description: The public share token, or null when the page is not published. The public URL is `<origin>/p/<token>`.

get.description: Returns the workspaces the authenticated user belongs to. Use an `id` from here as `workspaceId` everywhere else.
